product_one_liner.value: Mimica helps large enterprises capture and map business processes and turn workflows into production-ready AI agents.
product_one_liner.notes: https://www.mimica.ai/ describes capturing, mapping and automating processes for large enterprises; https://www.mimica.ai/articles/mimica-maker-ai-agents-watch-learn explains that Maker turns existing workflows into production-ready AI agents.

pricing_page.notes: The reviewed navigation/footer at https://www.mimica.ai/ provides contact/demo routes but no pricing link. https://www.mimica.ai/pricing returned only a redirect response, with no public plans or pricing content available.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Customer testimonials at https://www.mimica.ai/ identify Goodyear and ClearBank personnel describing their organizations' use of Mimica. | named_customers.0: The official homepage includes a Goodyear employee's testimonial describing use of Mimica. | named_customers.1: The official homepage includes a ClearBank executive's testimonial describing use of Mimica.

employee_band.notes: https://linkedin.com/company/mimica-automation reports 310 employees. https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/mimica-automation/employees reports approximately 314 worldwide as of June 2026, published August 2026. Both counts fall within 201-500.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/mimica-automation/employees explicitly names London as headquarters, corroborated by the London address on https://www.mimica.ai/. | hq_country: https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/mimica-automation/employees explicitly identifies Mimica Automation Ltd.'s headquarters as London, United Kingdom.

founded_year.notes: The company timeline at https://www.mimica.ai/about-us places Mimica's founding in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed index at https://www.mimica.ai/articles contains product introductions, process-automation guidance and business content. It does not establish two engineer-authored posts about building the product; the cited entries are representative product and marketing posts.

public_docs.notes: The reviewed homepage navigation/footer at https://www.mimica.ai/ has no documentation or help-center link. The resources at https://www.mimica.ai/guides are business and process-transformation guides rather than product usage documentation; no public docs/help site was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Senior/Lead Machine Learning Engineer posting at https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Mimica/157112c3-9fbf-440b-a5e4-5c40f0cd2fa0 describes ownership of ML pipelines and was verified on November 9, 2026.

model_provider.notes: Mimica's public engineering posting at https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/mimica/c69566a5-bcdf-4380-b40e-a7844acecfd8 explicitly names Claude (Anthropic), Gemini (Google) and GPT (OpenAI) for its agentic AI solutions. This is a delivery-role disclosure rather than a definitive statement that every core product uses all three.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: https://trust.mimica.ai/overview lists ISO 27001:2022, and https://www.mimica.ai/ explicitly claims ISO 27001 and GDPR compliance. GDPR is reported as a compliance claim, not an independently issued certification. | compliance_certs.0: Mimica's trust center explicitly lists ISO 27001:2022. | compliance_certs.1: Mimica's homepage explicitly claims GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest identified round is explicitly described as Series B in https://www.mimica.ai/articles/mimica-secures-26-2-million-in-series-b-funding-to-train-agentic-ai-on-real-enterprise-workflows. | funding_date: The latest identified funding announcement is dated September 24, 2025, yielding 2025-09: https://www.mimica.ai/articles/mimica-secures-26-2-million-in-series-b-funding-to-train-agentic-ai-on-real-enterprise-workflows. | funding_amount_usd: The latest identified round was $26.2 million, equivalent to USD 26,200,000, as stated in https://www.mimica.ai/articles/mimica-secures-26-2-million-in-series-b-funding-to-train-agentic-ai-on-real-enterprise-workflows. This is the round amount, not cumulative funding.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 24, 2025 funding announcement falls within the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025: https://www.mimica.ai/articles/mimica-secures-26-2-million-in-series-b-funding-to-train-agentic-ai-on-real-enterprise-workflows.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/mimica/b64e2711-b743-4d59-8115-15c46fda5095 is an Associate Business Development Representative posting with an active application link, satisfying the BDR criterion.

launched_6mo.notes: https://www.mimica.ai/articles/mimica-maker-ai-agents-watch-learn introduces Maker on September 30, 2026, within the six-month window beginning May 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Julio Acosta-Cabronero's dated profile at https://linkedin.com/in/julio-ac lists his Mimica VP of ML/AI role beginning in September 2026, within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The BDR posting at https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/mimica/b64e2711-b743-4d59-8115-15c46fda5095 instructs employees to maintain Salesforce and conduct outreach using Outreach and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. | crm_stack_signal.0: The BDR role requires maintaining account and pipeline details in Salesforce. | crm_stack_signal.1: The BDR role explicitly names Outreach as an outreach tool. | crm_stack_signal.2: The BDR role explicitly names LinkedIn Sales Navigator as an outreach tool.
